data.name: AeTerra
data.detailed_description:
Become the Spirit of Aeterra

You are the Spirit of Aeterra, a mystical flame gifted with the power to transform into the tools you carry. Adapt to your surroundings, gather resources, and overcome every challenge by choosing the right form.

Explore Procedural Islands

Every adventure takes you to a new procedurally generated island filled with unique landscapes, resources, secrets, and dangers. No two journeys are the same.

Craft Powerful Equipment

Gather materials from the world around you to craft new tools, weapons, and equipment. Upgrade your gear to face increasingly dangerous enemies.

Improve Through Experience

Your abilities grow stronger the more you use them. Develop your own playstyle as you master gathering, combat, and exploration.

Play Solo or With Friends

Embark on your adventure alone or team up with up to 4 players in online co-op. Work together to explore, fight, gather resources, and conquer the world of Aeterra.

Battle Monsters and Dungeon Bosses

Face relentless hordes of creatures, discover dangerous dungeons, and defeat powerful bosses guarding valuable rewards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 620, 1 GB or Intel HD Graphics 530
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
